lines.zh: 我一步一步，肚子擦着地。
lines.en: Step by step, my belly brushes the ground.
A push of my hind legs moves me a block.

lines.zh: 我走过草丛，草尖炸开小火星。
lines.en: As I pass, grass tips crackle with sparks.
A few bright points shine on my back.
I crouch, then shuffle on.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕的一声，冒了烟。
lines.en: My throat rumbles and gives off smoke.

lines.zh: 我往干燥的地方走，怕水。
lines.en: I head for dry ground; I dislike water.
Each landing pops with a crackle.

lines.zh: 我拖着肚子，慢慢蹭过去。
lines.en: I drag my belly and inch along.
The lights on my back blink.
I hop over a patch of cracked earth.
A few steps and I want to rest.
I squat, my belly swelling and sinking.
The sparks on my back brighten slowly.

lines.zh: 我吞了口气，没敢咽下去。
lines.en: I swallow air and dare not let it out.

lines.zh: 一只虫子停在石头上，我没动。
lines.en: A bug lands on stone; I stay still.
I am waiting for the moment to burst.
I swell up like a bladder.
The wind lifts my sparks.
I blink; my eyelids are thick.
The soil here is dry; good.
I slowly draw the air back in.
When I move, sparks fall off me.
I remember that I can shine.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上一动不动。
lines.en: I perch on the stone, motionless.

lines.zh: 远处有人在点什么东西。
lines.en: Someone far off is lighting something.
That fuse in your hand looks familiar.
Step back; I am feeling full.
I look up, my throat glowing.
I see a string of paper rolls at your belt.

lines.zh: 你点火的时候，别对着我。
lines.en: When you light it, don't point it at me.
The sparks on my back light you up.
You want to hold me? Be careful.

lines.zh: 我咕了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I croak once as a greeting.
My skin is a little hot.
You grin like you are about to set off fireworks.
Don't touch my back; it is hot.
I know your footsteps; they are light.
Will you take me up to the roof to watch?
I settle low so as not to frighten you.
The light in your eyes is lovely.
I have been waiting here all along.
The more powder I smell, the happier I am.
Count three and I will jump.
The pain makes me spark.
I flinch and my belly deflates.
That made me leak air.
I croak and shuffle back.
My skin is thick, and it still hurts.
Sparks fall all over the ground.
I shudder and my fire weakens.
You have dimmed my light.
I pant and my throat goes dry.
Stop; I fear I will burst.
I smell that packet of powder.
Give me a pinch, just a pinch.
I shuffle two blocks forward.
The smell of powder excites me.

lines.zh: 你把纸卷递过来，我接着。
lines.en: Pass the paper tube; I will take it.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，火星就冒出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and sparks come out.
It tastes sharp and sweet.
I swell up; you can see it.
Not all of it; I might lose control.
I rub against your boot.
One touch and I jitter.
The bump scatters sparks on the ground.
I am so round that a bump rolls me.
You got singed, didn't you? Sorry.
We collide and the grass tips scorch.
I shift away; don't press against me.

lines.zh: 我的肚子很软，撞不疼你。
lines.en: My belly is soft; it cannot hurt you.

lines.zh: 你踢了我一下，我不高兴。
lines.en: You kicked me; I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 滚完我翻不过来，帮个忙。
lines.en: I rolled over and cannot right myself; help?
There, I am set; stop bumping.
This body bursts when it gets excited.
Stay back; I fear I will hurt you.
I must first learn to hold my fire.
You asked the wrong toad.
I croak and turn my face away.
There is no second me in the pond.

lines.zh: 这种事对我来说太危险。
lines.en: That would be far too dangerous for me.
Let me manage myself first.
I squat and pretend not to hear.
Sparks crackle on my back.
I curl my tongue around it.
Too hot; I spit it out.
I hold it with both front feet.
It sinks under my belly.
I hold it in my mouth, wary of sparks.
Held in my mouth, and I fear it will pop.
I push twice and it rolls away.
It is not heavy; I will carry it.
I taste it; it is paper.
Keep it safe; don't let it fall in fire.
Something moved there; I turn.

lines.zh: 我鼓起来了，你最好别动。
lines.en: I am swelling; you had best stay still.
Fixed on it, and my throat is warm.
It does not smell of powder.

lines.zh: 我盯住那个方向，不眨眼。
lines.en: I fix that direction without blinking.
I shuffle toward it, slowly.
Fire turns inside my belly.
I swell up, my throat burning hot.
Get behind me.
Stay back from it; I will go.
It has crushed my stone.
I croak a warning.
When I am ready, I leap.
It did not hear me.
The light on my back brightens.
The fire in my belly rises to my throat.
I follow it in hops.

lines.zh: 它往草丛里钻，我压过去。
lines.en: It dives into grass; I press in.
My belly swells tighter and tighter.
It turns; I freeze.
The fire churns in my belly.
I see grass tips still scorched where it stepped.
It stops to breathe; I close in.
My sparks give me away.
It has stepped right beside me.
I make no sound; I only shuffle.
With each of its moves, I shift.
The grass tips curl from my heat.
I flatten the grass and creep closer.
Close enough; I hold my breath.
One turn and it will see me.
Half a block nearer and I leap.
I wait at the edge of its shadow.
The fire has reached my throat.

lines.zh: 我一头撞上去，火星四溅。
lines.en: I ram it and sparks fly.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，一小团火喷出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and a small flame comes out.
My brightness dazzles it.
I pounce and pin it with my belly.

lines.zh: 这一下炸得不响，但够疼。
lines.en: The burst is quiet but it stings.
I am thrown back and roll twice.
It stomps; I burn its foot.
I lash its leg with my tongue.
It backs off, afraid of my fire.
I only managed to make smoke with that blow.
One more; I can still hold.
It kicks; I keep my grip.

lines.zh: 我炸开一小片，它捂着脸。
lines.en: I burst a little and it covers its face.
I hop back and swell again.
Its fur is singed.
Good; it has retreated over there.

lines.zh: 我从模组的机制里被唤醒。
lines.en: I am awakened by the mod's means.
I let off a small string of sparks.

lines.zh: 我落在干土上，烫出一圈。
lines.en: I land on dry soil and scorch a ring.

lines.zh: 肚子里的第一口气是热的。
lines.en: My first breath is hot.
I look around; everything is damp.
I dislike the damp here.
I puff once to test myself.
Someone is near; I heard them.
My back begins to glow.
This body pops at the slightest touch.

lines.zh: 我挪到一块干燥的石头上。
lines.en: I shuffle onto a dry stone.
It is getting dark; good for being seen.

lines.zh: 我还不知道自己的脾气。
lines.en: I do not yet know my own temper.
I puff out a smoke ring.

lines.zh: 远处有火光，我要不要过去。
lines.en: There is firelight far off; should I go?
First I hold my breath in.
The damp makes my whole body itch.
Right; let me get used to it.

lines.zh: 火我不怕，可这火太旺了。
lines.en: I do not fear fire, but this one is too fierce.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，背上的亮点都灭了。
lines.en: I fall and the sparks on my back go out.

lines.zh: 水浸进来，我的火嘶地灭了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and my fire hisses out.

lines.zh: 炸得我滚出好远，肚子还响。
lines.en: The blast rolls me far and my belly still rings.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的背，扎破了火点。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my back and bursts a spark.
That force smothers my fire.

lines.zh: 没有火药，我连光都弱了。
lines.en: No powder, and even my light fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的亮点一起炸。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my sparks burst at once.

lines.zh: 没有地面，我的火在空处乱窜。
lines.en: No ground; my fire scatters in the emptiness.
